Identity

Identity states that two references pick out the same object within a declared framework.

editorialfoundations · logic
Run a related experimentTrace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

Identity states that two references pick out the same object within a declared framework.

EXACT

The compact statement

Equality is represented by a binary predicate = satisfying at least reflexivity and substitution of identicals in the chosen logic.

Example

If a=b, replacing a by b in an equality-respecting expression preserves its denotation.

Boundary / caveat

Definitional equality, propositional equality, isomorphism, and observational equivalence must not be silently conflated.

Assumptions

  • The declared logical framework context is fixed.
